backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the ICP backend implementing product management, user authentication (Internet Identity and username/password sessions), access control, and Amazon product metadata extraction via HTTP outcalls.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting two implemented features: fixing Rupee price display formatting in ProductGrid and changing the 'Shop on Amazon' button color to soft pink, both targeting frontend/src/components/ProductGrid.tsx.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON map of frontend source files to short summaries describing each component's purpose and recent changes, serving as a reference for the current state of the frontend codebase.
frontend/CLOUDFLARE_CDN_SETUP.md: Step-by-step guide for configuring Cloudflare CDN settings (minification, Brotli, caching, image optimization, HTTP/3) to improve performance of the RecomNow India website.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT_TROUBLESHOOTING.md: Documents a production deployment failure caused by a missing favicon asset and provides a Version 84 go-live checklist covering static assets, build verification, routing, service worker, and SEO checks.
frontend/index.html: Main HTML entry point with Google Analytics, SEO meta tags, Open Graph/Twitter cards, geo-location tags, structured data for the organization, and preload hints for critical assets.
frontend/PERFORMANCE_ACTION_PLAN.md: Phased performance optimization plan targeting Lighthouse scores of 90+ mobile and 95+ desktop, listing current issues and quick-win actions such as enabling Cloudflare optimizations and improving bundle splitting.
frontend/PERFORMANCE_OPTIMIZATION.md: Documents all performance optimizations implemented for the RecomNow India frontend, covering critical CSS inlining, image optimization, code splitting, service worker caching, Core Web Vitals tracking, and React Query configuration to achieve PageSpeed scores above 85.
frontend/public/robots.txt: Allows all crawlers to access the site and points to the sitemap URL.
frontend/public/sitemap.xml: XML sitemap listing the single homepage URL with daily change frequency and highest priority.
frontend/public/sw.js: Service worker implementing cache-first strategy for static assets and network-first for HTML/API calls, with versioned caches and cleanup of stale cache entries on activation.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component that handles client-side routing via popstate, lazily loads ProductsPage, AdminPage, and SitemapPage, and conditionally renders the Header, Footer, and PageModal.
frontend/src/components/admin/BlogManage: Placeholder admin component that displays a message indicating blog management functionality has been removed.
frontend/src/components/admin/Newsletter: Placeholder admin component that displays a message indicating newsletter management functionality has been removed.
frontend/src/components/admin/ProductMan: Admin panel for full CRUD management of products, including add/edit dialogs with category, pricing, and image fields, plus delete confirmation dialogs.
frontend/src/components/admin/SitePagesM: Placeholder admin component that displays a message indicating site pages management functionality has been removed.
frontend/src/components/AdminLogin.tsx: Login component supporting both Internet Identity and custom username/password authentication, with registration mode, password strength validation, and query cache invalidation on success.
frontend/src/components/AdminPanel.tsx: Admin dashboard component with a tabbed interface for managing Products, Blog, Newsletter, and Site Pages, plus a top bar showing the logged-in user and a logout button.
frontend/src/components/AmazonBanner.tsx: Placeholder component that renders nothing (returns null).
frontend/src/components/BlogPostModal.ts: Modal dialog that displays a static message indicating blog functionality has been removed.
frontend/src/components/BlogTeaser.tsx: Memoized component that previously showed blog teasers but now returns null since blog functionality has been removed.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Memoized footer component with newsletter signup form, quick navigation links, social media icons, and trust badges, supporting both SPA navigation and page modal opening.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Memoized sticky header with logo, site title, and navigation links for Home, Products, and Admin Panel, using SPA-style client-side routing.
frontend/src/components/Hero.tsx: Memoized hero banner section with a gradient background, headline, CTA buttons that scroll to the products section, and trust badges.
frontend/src/components/OptimizedImage.t: Lazy-loading image component using IntersectionObserver for viewport-based loading, WebP format preference, fallback error handling, and layout-stable aspect-ratio styles.
frontend/src/components/PageModal.tsx: Modal dialog that displays static content for predefined pages (Privacy Policy, Terms of Service, Contact) based on a pageKey prop, with a close button.
frontend/src/components/PasswordStrength: Displays a visual strength bar and feedback list for a given password string using the validatePasswordStrength utility, with color-coded weak/medium/strong states.
frontend/src/components/ProductGrid.tsx: Displays a paginated, filterable grid of products with category filters, price formatting, and affiliate links. Includes a ProductCard component with image, discount badge, and 'Shop on Amazon' CTA.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Empty file with no content or exports.
frontend/src/components/RobotsTxt.tsx: Empty file with no content or exports.
frontend/src/components/Sitemap.tsx: Empty file with no content or exports.
frontend/src/components/SocialProof.tsx: Renders a social proof section with static customer testimonials and an auto-rotating ticker of recent purchases using a timed interval.
frontend/src/components/Spinner.tsx: Simple animated SVG spinner component used as a loading indicator.
frontend/src/components/TrustBadges.tsx: Renders a configurable set of trust badge images (e.g., Amazon Associates, SSL Secure) in horizontal or vertical layout.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor using React Query, invalidating dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAuth.ts: Zustand store with persistence for managing a custom auth session token, username, and 24-hour expiry.
frontend/src/hooks/useBackendAuth.ts: Provides React Query mutations for user registration, login (storing session token), and logout against the ICP backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useDebounce.ts: Provides two utility hooks: useDebounce for debouncing a value and useDebouncedCallback for debouncing a callback function.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login/logout state, AuthClient creation, and identity persistence across page reloads.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching and mutating backend data including products, admin status, and user profiles, using the actor from useActor.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that sets up Tailwind directives and defines CSS custom properties for a gold-and-navy color scheme in both light and dark modes.
frontend/src/lib/web-vitals.d.ts: TypeScript declaration file providing type definitions for the web-vitals library's Metric interface and reporting functions.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin page component that handles authentication state (Internet Identity or custom session), shows a loading/error/access-denied UI, and renders either AdminLogin or AdminPanel based on auth status.
frontend/src/pages/ProductsPage.tsx: Simple page component that renders a header banner and the ProductGrid component for browsing all products.
frontend/src/pages/SitemapPage.tsx: Page component that generates and writes a basic XML sitemap directly to the document on mount, replacing the page content.
frontend/src/utils/delayedScripts.ts: Utility that defers injection of third-party scripts until 3 seconds after the page load event to improve Core Web Vitals.
frontend/src/utils/passwordValidation.ts: Provides functions to validate password strength (weak/medium/strong) based on length, character types, and special characters, plus a password-match check.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with helpers to persist, retrieve, and clear those parameters via sessionStorage.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration enabling dark mode, custom OKLCH-based color tokens (primary, gold, navy, sidebar, chart, etc.), container settings, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
frontend/vite.config.ts: Vite build configuration for a React/ICP frontend, defining path aliases, environment variable injection, dev-server proxy to a local DFX network, and optimized production chunking with Terser and LightningCSS.
project_state.json: Project state manifest for 'RecomNow India' tracking existing features and pending fix requests, specifically correcting Rupee price decimal display and changing the 'Shop on Amazon' button to soft pink.
